note: Machine-readable counterpart of the provenance prose in tests/catalog_data.rs. `generatedAt` is the commit timestamp of the pi revision the 31 embedded catalogs under providers/catalog/*.json were extracted from. It is the staleness floor for the pi.dev overlay (DRIFT-007): a persisted remote catalog whose Last-Modified is not strictly newer than this is discarded whole, so upgrading cyrup can never leave a pre-upgrade overlay shadowing freshly refreshed embedded data. Bump this in the same commit that refreshes the catalogs.
